title: 第1章 万界词条！一阶基因锁！（新人求收藏！）
slug: 万界词条从基因锁词条开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“2044年，蓝星被虚界捕获，撕裂成了无数碎片，坠入虚界！”

“为了不被虚界彻底吞噬，蓝星意志用最后的本源，让所有人类获得了数据面板。”

“只要人类变强，就能增强蓝星本源，甚至能开启通往其他同样被虚界捕获的世界传送门！”

觉醒室，数十人坐在椅子上，听着讲台上老师说话，气氛十分压抑。

罗兰此刻默默合上眼前只有几页纸的小册子，心中沉重：“现在，距离蓝星被虚界捕获，已经过去了十五年！”

而他，便是在蓝星坠入虚界的前三年出生的。

虚界到底是什么，没人能说清，只知道它仿佛像是黑洞一样，不断吞噬着其他世界。

而一旦被其吞噬，便只有坠入虚界这一个结局！

罗兰知道，在他所在的这块蓝星碎片附近，就存在着同样坠入虚界的不知名世界碎片。

这是在三天前才坠入虚界的世界碎片，当时产生的动静，令罗兰所在的地方都仿佛像是地震了一样。

讲台上老师滔滔不绝，说着罗兰他们早就耳熟能详的话：“你们能坐在这里，就代表你们已经十八岁了！或许有的人还要再等几个月才是十八岁的生日，但是这不重要，蓝星意志同样会在今天为你们开启数据面板！”

罗兰坐在椅子上，默默等待。

为了节约本源，只有十八岁的人，才会被蓝星意志开启数据面板。

而开启数据面板之后，第二天清晨，他们就要前往试炼世界！

而所谓的试炼世界，其实便是其他被虚界捕获的世界碎片，其中隐藏着不知道多少威胁！

而根据聚集地过往的经验，今天便是蓝星为他开启数据面板的日子。

等待中，罗兰不知不觉想起了他上一辈子的事情。

霓虹灯光，摩天大楼这些景象一一闪过，最终停留在了一辆泥头车上！

“明明已经过去了十八年，但是一想起来......”

罗兰深深吸了一口气：“依旧如此记忆犹新！如果不是这样，我恐怕早就把上一世当成一场梦了！”

上一世和这一世对比，的确宛如梦幻一般。

这一世蓝星坠入虚界，世界被撕裂成了无数碎片，各个碎片之间难以交流，饥荒、天灾不断，更有一些虚界之中的怪物入侵，这一世他活的艰难无比！

而就在这个时候，一道平静、没有丝毫特色，宛如机器一般的声音在罗兰耳边响起：“数据面板开启！”

“开启了！”罗兰猛地睁开双眼，心中一凝。

正当他准备

【无尽词条加载成功！】

下一刻，这行文字便消散一空。

“无尽词条？”

罗兰神色一顿：“这不是上一世我玩游戏时嫌战士职业不够强，因此下载的插件吗？它居然也跟着我一起过来了？”

“如果它能起作用的话.......”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"In 2044, Blue Star was captured by the virtual world, torn into countless pieces, and fell into the virtual world!"

"In order not to be completely swallowed by the virtual world, Blue Star Will used its last source to allow all humans to obtain data panels."

"As long as humans become stronger, they can strengthen the origin of Blue Star, and even open portals to other worlds that are also captured by the virtual world!"

In the awakening room, dozens of people were sitting on chairs, listening to the teacher on the podium, and the atmosphere was very depressing.

At this moment, Roland silently closed the booklet with only a few pages in front of him, his heart heavy: "Now, fifteen years have passed since Blue Star was captured by the virtual world!"

And he was born three years before Blue Star fell into the virtual world.

No one can explain what the virtual world is. They only know that it seems to be like a black hole, constantly devouring other worlds.

And once it is swallowed up, the only ending is to fall into the virtual world!

Roland knew that near the fragment of the blue star where he was, there were fragments of an unknown world that had also fallen into the virtual world.

This was a fragment of the world that fell into the virtual world just three days ago. The movement made at that time made the place where Roland was located feel like an earthquake.

The teacher on the podium kept talking, saying what Roland and the others had long heard: "The fact that you are sitting here means that you are already eighteen years old! Some people may have to wait a few more months for their eighteenth birthday, but that is not important. Blue Star Will will also open the data panel for you today!"

Roland sat on the chair and waited silently.

In order to save the source, only those who are eighteen years old can open the data panel at the will of Blue Star.

After opening the data panel, they will head to the trial world early the next morning!

The so-called trial world is actually the fragments of other worlds captured by the virtual world, and there are countless threats hidden in them!

According to the past experience of the gathering place, today is the day when Blue Star opens the data panel for him.

While waiting, Roland unconsciously remembered what happened in his previous life.

Neon lights and skyscrapers flashed by one by one, and finally stopped at a dump truck!

"Eighteen years have obviously passed, but when I think about it..."

Roland took a deep breath: "The memory is still fresh in my mind! If it weren't for this, I might have regarded the previous life as a dream!"

Comparing the previous life with this one, it is indeed like a dream.

In this life, Blue Star fell into the virtual world, and the world was torn into countless fragments. It was difficult to communicate between the fragments. Famine, natural disasters continued, and some monsters in the virtual world invaded. His life in this life was extremely difficult!

And at this moment, a calm, featureless, machine-like voice sounded in Roland's ears: "Data panel is on!"

"It's on!" Roland suddenly opened his eyes and his heart condensed.

Just as he was getting ready

[Endless entries loaded successfully!】

The next moment, this line of text disappeared.

"Endless entries?"

Roland paused for a moment: "Isn't this the plug-in I downloaded when I was playing the game in my last life because I thought the warrior class was not strong enough? And it actually came with me?"

"If it works..."
